description: Manage the Organization's Agents, Skills and Projects as the person who created the calling Project.

projectForm.label: Always allowed
projectForm.text: The Project can view the Agents and Skills its creator can see, the Projects it created and its Other Projects.

projectForm.label: Other Projects
projectForm.help:
Existing Projects it may view. With **Open and restart Projects** on, it can also open and restart them. It never deletes them.
Only Projects its creator can open count, so pick ones in shared Workspaces.

projectForm.label: Edit Skills and Agents
projectForm.help: Create and update Skills, and change Agents' instructions, model, files and Skills. Only ones it created, or the one its Builder chat is building.

projectForm.label: Create Agents
projectForm.help: New Agents are private to the Project's creator. Editing them needs **Edit Skills and Agents**.

projectForm.label: Agent limit
projectForm.help: How many Agents it may have created at once. Deleting one frees a slot.

projectForm.label: Create Projects
projectForm.help: New Projects belong to the Project's creator. Turn on to also choose their Agents, Workspace and limit.

projectForm.label: Allowed Agents
projectForm.help:
Agents its new Projects may use. Leave empty to allow any.
Only Agents the Project's creator can start count.

projectForm.label: Workspace for new Projects
projectForm.help:
Shared Workspace its new Projects go to. Leave empty to let it choose.
The Project's creator must be a member.

projectForm.label: Project limit
projectForm.help: How many Projects it may have created at once, Test Projects included. Deleting one frees a slot.

projectForm.label: Open and restart Projects
projectForm.help: Chat with, run commands in and restart the Projects it created and its Other Projects.

projectForm.label: Delete Projects
projectForm.help: Only Projects it created, never Other Projects.
